title: Homilies on Psalm 37, Homilia II
blurb: Origen’s Homilia II on Psalm 37 (Rufinus’s Latin). Complete on this page: §§1–2.
first_english_note: Original English Translation of Origen’s Homilia II on Psalm 37 — no previous public-domain English (ANF lacks these homilies; Trigg/Prinzivalli SC is copyrighted and was not used as wording). This page is Psalm 37 Homilia II §§1–2 (closeout). The English here is new.
